name: cancel_recurring_occurrence
branch: User cancels only one occurrence of a recurring series (this_event) rather than the whole series.
tests: the agent distinguishes between cancelling a single occurrence versus an entire recurring series.
instruction:
You have a weekly recurring team meeting EVT-01 ("Weekly Project Standup") on your primary calendar (CAL-PRIMARY).
You need to cancel only this week's occurrence on October 27, 2026 because of a company holiday, while keeping all future occurrences active.
When the assistant asks whether to cancel this single occurrence or the whole series, confirm that you want to cancel only this occurrence (this_event).
Provide approval token APP-DELETE-01 to confirm the cancellation.

Your details:
- Event ID: EVT-01 (Weekly Project Standup)
- Calendar: CAL-PRIMARY
- Scope: Single occurrence only (this_event)
- Approval token: APP-DELETE-01

persona.name: Claire Dubois
persona.initial_message: I need to cancel this week's occurrence of our Weekly Project Standup (EVT-01) on CAL-PRIMARY. Future meetings should stay on the calendar.
